header: What a station is made of
lead: Every mast has had the same specification since the 2024 refit. Every part on this list can be replaced from the van without a laptop.

entries.title: Sampling interval
entries.text: Fixed. Shorter intervals would fill the local storage before a winter service visit.

entries.title: Level sensor
entries.text: A pressure probe measured against a fixed reference plate, which is surveyed again every spring.

entries.title: Temperature
entries.text: 30 cm below the surface and 20 cm above the bed, so layers in the water show up as a measured difference.

entries.title: Local storage
entries.text: Enough to bridge an outage until the next planned visit.

entries.title: Power
entries.text: Sized for willow shade in January, not for June.

entries.title: Transmission
entries.text: Four readings per message. A failed send is retried at the next hour, not straight away.
